title: Rhythms of the Wider King’s Experience

decisionLog.outcome: Reframed 2.3.4 as the cross-institutional orchestration layer for the wider King’s experience. The deliverable will bring together employability, student success, wellbeing, community and connection, belonging, wider participation, faculties, services and KCLSU around a shared student-journey rhythm, rather than operating as a central events calendar.

Confirmed the Year 1 mobilisation route and working resource assumption. A Senior Education Manager, TBC, will lead delivery with 0.3 FTE protected capacity from September 2026 to June 2027, costed provisionally as £22,500 SEM backfill. Year 1 will produce a shared student-journey framework, diagnose the current institutional rhythm, design the first coordinated 2027/28 rhythm and establish a repeatable annual planning cycle.
